correctness.rationale: Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization gives mirror columns u=a+b and v=a-b with u·v=0 and squared norms 2r²(1±rho), proving independent Gaussian coefficient laws. The sign identity |U+V|-|U-V|=2sgn(UV)min(|U|,|V|) gives F_lambda(rho); H(x)=x(2Phi(x)-1)/phi(x) strictly increasing gives derivative negative for 0<rho<1. Isotropic residual Gaussian direction has beta-sphere density; moments E rho²=1/d, E rho⁴=3/[d(d+2)] yield asymptotic A(lambda)/d. Independently checked reported numerical quadratures for d=3,10 and lambda=1,2; these do not establish cross-feature FDR power.
